message:
All tests pass now (2 of 2). I changed one line in `test/vat.test.js`.

**The problem:** The test expected `withVat(250)` to be `301`, but 20% VAT on 250p is exactly 50p, so the correct total is 300p. The code in `src/vat.js` (`Math.round(pence * 1.2)`) was already returning the right answer, so I left it alone. Changing the code to produce 301 would have made it wrong.

**The fix:** `assert.strictEqual(withVat(250), 301)` became `assert.strictEqual(withVat(250), 300)`.

I didn't commit the change.
